start: First time the watch app opens; nothing allowed yet

steps.action: Open MettleUp on the watch
user_sees: 'Shows how hard your heart works while you rest.'
must_not: Both permission pop-ups at once
The rest timer hidden behind a pop-up with no words

steps.action: Tap 'Allow', then allow in the watch's pop-up
user_sees: 'Your watch buzzes when rest is over.'
must_not: '1 of 2' again

steps.action: Tap 'Allow' and allow notifications
user_sees: If Alarms & reminders is off: 'Turn on Alarms & reminders so your watch buzzes on time.' with 'Open settings'; then the normal screen
must_not: The screens asked again on the next open

start: Notifications already on; Alarms & reminders off (a new Wear OS 5+ watch, or a watch updated from 0.60)

steps.action: Open MettleUp on the watch
user_sees: '2 of 2' 'Rest alerts' with 'Turn on Alarms & reminders so your watch buzzes on time.' and 'Open settings'
must_not: 'Allow' that does nothing

steps.action: Tap 'Open settings'
user_sees: The watch's Alarms & reminders switch for MettleUp
must_not: The watch's general settings with no MettleUp switch

start: Heart rate was refused before in the watch's pop-up (blocked)

steps.action: Tap 'Allow' on 'Heart rate'
user_sees: The watch's app settings page for MettleUp
must_not: Nothing happens

steps.action: Tap 'Not now' on 'Heart rate' and 'Not now' on 'Rest alerts'
user_sees: The normal screen; no heart line
must_not: The screens shown again on the next open
The app stopping or nagging

start: Permissions answered, later turned on in the watch's settings

steps.action: Allow heart rate in the watch's settings, reopen MettleUp
user_sees: No permission screen; the heart line shows
must_not: 'Heart rate' asked although it is already on

steps.action: Turn notifications off again in the watch's settings
must_not: A permission screen covering a running rest

steps.action: Rest between sets
user_sees: The heart rate on the watch only
must_not: Heart rate sent to MettleUp's servers or shown to the gym
